control.change_summary: Adopt schema 3.1 and the private faculty course template identity. Assigned faculty access is enforced by GitHub repository permissions. Inherit the selected Atlas SOE and its deployment-aware requirements and launch profiles. Describe planned sanitized student distribution, retaining only .faculty/README.md inside .faculty and rewriting repository identity and launch links for the destination.

student_distribution.notes: Planned GitHub Action; disabled until an approved workflow and destination repository are configured. Publish a sanitized snapshot to the selected student repository, retaining only .faculty/README.md within .faculty. Omit faculty Git history; replace faculty repository identity, visibility and audience metadata with destination-specific values and omit this faculty-only distribution configuration. Generate launch links for that destination. Repository visibility and assigned-faculty permissions are GitHub settings, not access grants provided by this manifest.
